Class DrawCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.interactive.CardEffectInteractive
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.effects.interactive.DrawCard
public class DrawCard extends CardEffectInteractive
An interactive card effect that grants the owning player a card draw.

The draw type (upper or lower row) is determined by drawCardType. Applying this effect delegates to DrawCardEnum.apply(Player, DrawCardEnum), which creates and returns the corresponding pending Action.
